chunks: And Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id informed us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Mufaddal ibn Ibrahim al-Ash'ari narrated to us, saying: He narrated to me Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurara, from Marzban al-Qummi, from Imran al-Ash'ari, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, that he said:

Three [types of people] whom Allah will not look at on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify, and for them is a painful punishment: One who claims that he is an Imam but is not an Imam, and one who claims that the true Imam is not an Imam while he is an Imam, and one who claims that these two have a share in Islam.
ai.seo_question: Who are the three people Allah will not look at on the Day of Judgment according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies three specific groups who will face divine neglect and painful punishment on the Day of Resurrection. These groups include false claimants to imamate, those who deny the true Imam's status while being imams themselves, and those who consider both the false and true claimants to be valid Muslims. This hadith from al-Nu'mani's *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the critical Shia doctrine of distinguishing between the divinely appointed Imam and pretenders, emphasizing that validity in Islam is tied to recognizing the true Imam's authority.
